column2: Waʾaqīmū l-wazna bilqisṭi walā tukhsirū l-mīzān
Wakhalaqa l-jānna min mārijin min nār
Walahu l-jawāri l-munshātu fi l-baḥri kalʾaʿlām
Wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū l-jalāli walʾikrām
Yasaluhu man fi s-samāwāti walʾarḍi kulla yawmin huwa fi shaʾn
Yāmaʿshara l-jinni walʾinsi ʾini staṭaʿtum ʾan tanfudhū min ʾaqṭāri s-samāwāti walʾarḍi fanfudhū lā tanfudhūna ʾillā bisulṭān
Yursalu ʿalaykumā shuwāẓun min nārin wanuḥāsun falā tantaṣirān
Faʾidhā nshaqqati s-samāʾu fakānat wardatan kalddihān
Fayawmaʾidhin lā yusalu ʿan dhanbihi ʾinsun walā jānn
Yuʿrafu l-mujrimūna bisīmāhum fayuʾkhadhu bilnnawāṣi walʾaqdām
Hādhihi jahannamu lati yukadhdhibu bihā l-mujrimūn
Muttakīna ʿalā furushin baṭāʾinuhā min ʾistabraqin wajanā l-jannatayni dān
Fīhinna qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarfi lam yaṭmithhunna ʾinsun qablahum walā jānn
Lam yaṭmithhunna ʾinsun qablahum walā jānn
Muttakīna ʿalā rafrafin khuḍrin waʿabqariyyin ḥisān
Tabāraka smu rabbika dhi l-jalāli walʾikrām
